Moss's 30 September digest lists it as ticket #8841. Mateo reported that drivers arriving for the second shift at Newark couldn't select Dock Door 14 on the check-in kiosk. The digest says you escalated it to the platform engineering queue.

Check that number before you send it to engineering. In #strategic-pod on 1 July, you said you closed out #8841 with support. That one was about Vantorre's Detention Summary CSV export and a kiosk tablet cache issue. The digest may have reused or mistyped the number. I found no other Door 14 ticket number in anything you can see. Your support queue or your escalation message should confirm the right one.
